title: fix(plugin-chatbot): composer accept list reads the HTML accept grammar; a refused type is named to the user
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg48yiCyRmnqoUoHcQ9VbBp6)_

Fixes #35276

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 聊天输入框的附件类型判断改为按 HTML `accept` 语法（`.ext` 按文件名后缀、`type/*` 按 MIME 前缀、其余按 MIME 精确匹配，均不区分大小写）；被拒的文件在输入框上方的提示条里点名并列出允许的类型。
- 为什么改：默认允许列表是 `.pdf,.csv,.xlsx…` 这类后缀，旧逻辑拿它和 MIME 类型逐字比较，永远不相等——用户选了 CSV / PDF 却静默附不上，只有控制台有一条 warn。
- 风险与回滚：仅 `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` 一个包、纯前端；回滚即 revert 本 PR。`onError` 对“部分被拒”的选择多回调一次（同 `code: 'accept'`，带 `files`），不读 `files` 的宿主行为不变。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/elements/prompt-input.tsx`（`fileMatchesAccept` 与 `addLocal` 的拒收上报）、`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`（`handlePromptInputError` 的 accept 分支与同一次选择的提示合并）、测试文件 `ChatbotEnhanced.sendError.test.tsx` 新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.sendError.test.tsx`，预期 22 passed（含新增 8 条 objectstack#35276 用例）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `PromptInput` (vendored AI Elements, `elements/prompt-input.tsx`): the accept check moves into one module-level helper, `fileMatchesAccept`, that reads the HTML `accept` grammar: a `.ext` token matches the end of the file NAME, a `type/*` token matches the MIME prefix, any other token matches the MIME type exactly, all case-insensitive; an empty list admits everything. The helper is not exported (no new public symbol).
- `addLocal` now reports EVERY type-refused file through `onError({ code: 'accept', files })`, in the all-refused case and in a mixed pick, mirroring the `max_file_size` shape the previous composer-notice change added. Before, a mixed pick dropped the type-failing files with no report, and the all-refused report carried no `files`.
- `ChatbotEnhanced`: `handlePromptInputError` shows an `accept` refusal in the existing `ComposerNotice` band (`chat-attachment-refused`), naming the refused files and the accepted list. The sentence reuses the existing pack key `fields.file.typeNotAccepted` (present in every built-in locale pack), so no locale file changes and no new key. Refusals reported by one pick (wrong type and over size) are joined into one notice instead of the second replacing the first.
- Changeset: `.changeset/35276-composer-accept-tokens.md`, `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the existing composer-notice harness `ChatbotEnhanced.sendError.test.tsx` (8 cases):

- a CSV and a PDF picked with the default accept list attach, with no notice;
- a `.ext` token matches the name case-insensitively whatever type the browser reported (`EXPORT.CSV` with an empty type, `Book.XLSX` as `application/octet-stream`);
- extension, wildcard and exact-MIME tokens (`image/*,.CSV,application/pdf`) each admit their own files and nothing else (`video/mp4` and `application/x-pdf` refused);
- a refused type shows the notice (`role="alert"`) naming the file and the accepted list, and is not attached;
- a mixed pick attaches the accepted file and names only the refused one;
- one pick refused for type and for size names both files;
- CONTROL: a `.png` with the default list attaches with no notice;
- under zh the notice is the zh pack sentence, not the English one (proves the borrowed key resolves through the pack, not only through its English default).

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation proven on disk by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

The test resolves `../ChatbotEnhanced` from source, so no rebuild is involved.

1. Extension arm off in `fileMatchesAccept` (`if (token.startsWith(".")) {` to `if (false && token.startsWith(".")) {`): 4 failed / 18 passed, the CSV-and-PDF, case-insensitive-extension, grammar and mixed-pick cases red.
2. Notice branch off in `handlePromptInputError` (the `e.code === 'accept'` arm to `false`): 5 failed / 17 passed, the grammar, refused-type, mixed-pick, type-and-size and zh cases red.
3. Mixed-pick report off in `addLocal` (`if (refused.length > 0) {` to `if (refused.length > 0 && accepted.length === 0) {`): 3 failed / 19 passed, the grammar, mixed-pick and type-and-size cases red.

Every restore: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Multi-file refusal grammar: the borrowed sentence is singular (`"NAME" is not an accepted file type (LIST)`); a pick refusing several files lists their names inside it. A plural-aware sentence would need a new key in every published locale pack (a widening), which the dispatch asked to avoid when an existing sentence fits.
- Two copies of the accept grammar now exist under `ui/`: this one and the private `matchesAcceptEntry` / `acceptError` in `@object-ui/fields` `FileField.tsx`. They differ deliberately in one point: the field widget admits a pick no entry can be weighed against (mirroring the server's save-time check), while the composer has no server check behind it and refuses. Noted, not filed (no defect).
- `PromptInputProvider`'s `attachments.add` (provider mode) applies no accept, size or count check at all; `ChatbotEnhanced` does not use provider mode, so nothing reaches it today. Noted, not filed.
- Browser: verified in jsdom only (as the card was filed); no live-app run.
